explanation: The theorem says two functors out of the fundamental groupoid of X are equal if they agree after restricting along the inclusions of a family of sets whose interiors cover X. This is a Seifert–van Kampen-type statement. I found nothing like it in Mathlib. I grepped Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroupoid for ext, cover, nhds and iSup-of-subtypeVal lemmas, and found no relevant result. I also searched all of Mathlib for "van Kampen" and "Seifert"; the only hits are the categorical van Kampen colimits in CategoryTheory/Limits/VanKampen.lean and related files, which have nothing to do with topology. The library's proof depends on its own lemma iSup_im_map_subtypeVal_eq_top together with generic Subgroupoid and Functor.ext machinery.
